name: Automated Application Security Scanning
description: Run automated application level tests against the application using OWASP ZAP

steps.name: a new browser or client instance
the default user logs in
the user is logged in
the case of the password is changed
the authentication tokens on the client are deleted
the login page is displayed
the user logs in
the user is not logged in

elements.name: Present the login form itself over an HTTPS connection

steps.name: a new browser instance
the client/browser is configured to use an intercepting proxy
the login page is displayed
the HTTP request-response containing the login form
the protocol should be HTTPS

elements.name: Disable browser auto-completion on the login form

steps.name: a new browser instance
the login page is displayed
the login form is inspected
it should have the autocomplete attribute set to 'off'

name: Authentication
description: Verify that the authentication system is robust

elements.name: Issue a new session ID after authentication

steps.name: a new browser or client instance
the login page
the value of the session ID is noted
the default user logs in
the user is logged in
the value of the session cookie issued after authentication should be different from that of the previously noted session ID

elements.name: Set the 'secure' flag on the session cookie

steps.name: a new browser or client instance
the default user logs in
the user is logged in
the session cookie should have the secure flag set

elements.name: Set the 'httpOnly' flag on the session cookie

steps.name: a new browser or client instance
the client/browser is configured to use an intercepting proxy
the default user logs in
the user is logged in
